description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Revenue Protection Act No. 19 of 1962 R.P.O. No. 01/2022
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order made by the Minister of Finance under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962. It specifies new customs duty rates and exemptions for various imported goods (fish, crustaceans, molluscs), which constitutes regulatory changes to customs and revenue laws. The content focuses on legal instruments and regulatory compliance rather than government personnel changes or organizational structure.
